purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Katwa

queries.query: Katwa West Bengal official cadastral map land records parcel viewer
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of India DILRMP Katwa-II village-level map-digitization record, which says maps were digitized, spatial data verified, linked with RoR, and that eBhuchitra was used. It also identified the official West Bengal Banglarbhumi land-record portal and the Department of Land Resources state portal listing.

queries.result: Bengali discovery returned the same first-party West Bengal land-record context and Katwa subdivision references, including the official DILRMP Katwa-II map-digitization record. No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

registryEvidence: The first-party DILRMP record is specifically for West Bengal, Purba Bardhaman, Katwa-II and records cadastral-map digitization status, including eBhuchitra as the map software. The Department of Land Resources also lists Banglarbhumi as West Bengal's RoR portal. This evidences a state/local cadastral custodian and service lead, but not an open parcel API response for the city point.

officialSources.observation: Government of India DILRMP map-digitization record for West Bengal, Purba Bardhaman, Katwa-II; lists village map status and eBhuchitra usage.
Official West Bengal Banglarbhumi land-record portal route; current page could not be fetched during this attempt.
Official Department of Land Resources page listing Banglarbhumi for West Bengal and describing state-maintained textual/spatial land records.

source: Government of India DILRMP Katwa-II map-digitization evidence / West Bengal Banglarbhumi lead

requestOutcomes.outcome: First-party indexed page identified Katwa-II, Purba Bardhaman, West Bengal and reported digitization/status fields. Direct browser fetch returned a 502 in this attempt; no parcel feature response was exposed.
TLS-default curl timed out after 15 seconds with no response body. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, retry with private tokens, or TLS exception was attempted.
TLS-default request succeeded. The official page listed Banglarbhumi as West Bengal's RoR portal and described cadastral maps/spatial records in general; it did not provide a Katwa parcel response.

An official West Bengal ArcGIS REST route was attempted as a possible public map service. TLS-default curl timed out after 20 seconds before metadata or geometry was received; no parcel schema, CRS, or native identity was qualified.

schemaAndCrs.qualification: The DILRMP evidence confirms cadastral-map digitization activity but does not expose a safe machine-readable parcel feature in this attempt.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Katwa city queue point, with official West Bengal/Purba Bardhaman/Katwa-II cadastral service evidence.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local/state cadastral custody and digitization evidence only; no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response or citywide parcel coverage was qualified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
remainingUncertainty: Banglarbhumi/eBhuchitra may expose cadastral maps interactively when reachable, and the official West Bengal GIS route may have related services, but current JavaScript/configuration and parcel responses could not be inspected. The exact WUP point was preserved and not used as an absence test. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested. No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel identity and full parcel polygon were observed. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
